_comment: Channel selection study: which image channel should the AprilGrid detector see underwater? Every setting of the experiment is here; run_study.py and analyse_study.py read nothing else. Paths are relative to the project root.

calibration._why: The settings every Calibration.py run in the study shares, so the channel is the only thing that changes between runs.

angle_names._why: Optional description of each board angle (scan code in the folder name), shown in the recall figure's panel titles.

test_target._why: Held-out stereo pairs of a different target, never used to calibrate, triangulated with each channel's Water calibration. The tags are ordinary AprilTags (1-bit border), unlike the Kalibr board (2-bit), so only markerBorderBits differs from the calibration preset.
